fix.migration_guide: Mechanical path rewrite at every call site: replace the removed '/intel/ip-list' segment with '/intel/ip-lists' in raw URL builders, route constants, and API client wrappers. The resource semantics are unchanged (same intel IP list catalog read), so no request or response handling edits are required beyond the one-segment rename.
